title: IPEX Planners - Akamai NetStorage Areas Breakdown
content:
As ESI redirects will be unsupported by Akamai in a few months we searched for ESI files in both the old and new Akamai NetStorage areas. While doing this job we concluded many products still reside on the old Akamai NetStorage area. Some planners have partly moved to the new area; e.g., non-production in the new area, but production still in the old area. It should be noted that moving planners to the new area involves some job both for the planner team, and for the IPEX DevOps Team. Migration is described here. Below is an overview for the production CP codes (407446 = old area, 809386 = new area). The “Planner/product” column may not refer to the specific name of the planner or team - it is the root directories in the Akamai areas.
